fichas.title: Wardrobes and linen cupboards
fichas.summary: Guidance on wardrobe and linen-cupboard contents, configurations, placement, and fitting out. Wardrobes may be free-standing, built-in, or part of a walk-in wardrobe or dressing room. The page recommends planning adequate space and ventilation, particularly for wardrobes on external walls and walk-in wardrobes.
uses: Store clothing, linen, shoes, and suitcases
Fit out rented or owner-occupied homes

Details and fitting out
Wardrobes and linen cupboards are an essential part of fitting out
a home. They serve to store (larger) items of clothing, linen, shoes
and suitcases, and are normally situated in the bedroom.

The essential elements of a wardrobe are a drawer unit, a
hanging rail and additional shelves. It can be a free-standing
wardrobe -7 0. a built-in wardrobe (wall cupboard, single or
double wardrobe constructions) -7 f)- 0 or in the form of a walkin wardrobe or dressing room -7 0

-e.

Built-in wardrobe wall units -7 0 are useful as partitions between
bedrooms. In small rooms space can be optimally used with
cupboards built into wall niches -7 0 with continuous flooring
(and sliding doors).

taken that the thermal insulation is adequate and that ventilation
is provided. Walk-in wardrobes also require appropriate
ventilation -7 0.

Details and fitting out
Wardrobes and linen cupboards are an essential part of fitting out
a home. They serve to store (larger) items of clothing, linen, shoes
and suitcases, and are normally situated in the bedroom.

The essential elements of a wardrobe are a drawer unit, a
hanging rail and additional shelves. It can be a free-standing
wardrobe -7 0. a built-in wardrobe (wall cupboard, single or
double wardrobe constructions) -7 f)- 0 or in the form of a walkin wardrobe or dressing room -7 0

-e.

Built-in wardrobe wall units -7 0 are useful as partitions between
bedrooms. In small rooms space can be optimally used with
cupboards built into wall niches -7 0 with continuous flooring
(and sliding doors).
